CREATE TABLE "DownloadClient" (
  "credentialCiphertext" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "url" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "username" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
